Owner and operator · acquired and built the territory from zero

$200k
Monthly revenue at peak

I acquired a franchise territory and built the operation from zero. Hired and trained the outside sales team, set pricing and the offer, owned the P&L and the books, ran the CRM, and generated every lead in-house through local search and paid media.

15
Hired and managed
100%
P&L ownership
The business reached $200k a month and never cleared acceptable margin. Franchise fees on top of a shared-lead model put three contractors on every estimate, and price was the only variable left. I chose to close it rather than subsidize it. Two years carrying a P&L, a payroll and a pricing model taught me more about unit economics and sales behaviour than any marketing role had.

What I actually operate

01

Outbound

TAM definition, list construction and waterfall enrichment in Clay and Apollo, trigger and signal scoring, domain and inbox infrastructure, sequence copy, reply handling. I build the system, not just the campaign.

02

Search and AI answers

Keyword and content strategy, technical SEO, link acquisition and competitor gap analysis. Plus answer engine optimization: placing a brand into the third-party sources that ChatGPT and Perplexity assemble answers from.

03

Paid

Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, Shopping and Amazon. Creative testing at volume, hook iteration, audience and remarketing architecture, budget allocated against blended CAC rather than platform-reported ROAS.

04

Content and distribution

Original research and benchmark studies, founder content repurposed into distribution, free tools as an acquisition channel, and short-form video. I write the work rather than brief it out.

05

Measurement

GA4, HubSpot, Search Console, Ahrefs, VWO. Attribution modeling, channel CAC, funnel reporting and dashboards a board actually reads. I instrument before I spend.

06

Lifecycle and CRO

Email and lifecycle systems, activation and onboarding flows, and structured experimentation. Google Optimize, VWO and HubSpot workflows.
